# FICTIONAL OFFLINE COLLECTION FIXTURES

Everything in this directory and in `fake_tools/` is invented test data/code.
The test HTTP server substitutes its local address for `{{BASE}}`. Audio is a
three-second sine wave generated by ffmpeg; captions are fictional assertions,
not transcriptions of that wave. Fake yt-dlp and faster-whisper adapters are used
only by offline subprocess tests via PYTHONPATH. Production code has no fixture
switch. Real media/transcription are separately exercised by the live smoke test.
